mapper.select: SELECT member_idx AS memberIdx, member_id AS memberId, member_pwd AS memberPwd, member_name AS memberName, member_gender AS memberGender, member_email AS memberEmail, member_phone AS memberPhone, member_level AS memberLevel, member_status AS memberStatus FROM tb_member order by member_idx desc
mapper.update: update tb_member set member_name=#{memberName}, member_pwd=#{memberPwd}, member_email=#{memberEmail}, member_phone=#{memberPhone}, member_gender=#{memberGender}, member_level=#{memberLevel}, member_status=#{memberStatus} where member_idx=#{memberIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT member_idx AS memberIdx, member_id AS memberId, member_pwd AS memberPwd, member_name AS memberName, member_email AS memberEmail, member_phone AS memberPhone, member_level AS memberLevel FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT room_idx AS accNo, room_name AS accName, room_size AS accLocation, room_price_weekdays AS accPrice FROM tb_room

SELECT r.rv_code AS resNo, m.member_id AS memberId, m.member_name AS resName, ro.room_name AS accName, if(year(now())=year(r.rv_start_date), DATE_FORMAT(r.rv_start_date,'%m/%d'), DATE_FORMAT(r.rv_start_date,'%Y/%m/%d')) AS checkIn, if(year(now())=year(r.rv_end_date), DATE_FORMAT(r.rv_end_date,'%m/%d'), DATE_FORMAT(r.rv_start_date,'%Y/%m/%d')) AS checkOut, r.rv_status AS resStatus FROM tb_reservation r JOIN tb_member m ON r.rv_member_idx = m.member_idx JOIN tb_room ro ON r.rv_room_idx = ro.room_idx order by rv_idx desc

SELECT b.board_idx AS id, b.board_title AS title, b.board_create_idx AS writer, m.member_id AS memberId, b.board_create_date AS createdAt, b.board_hit_cnt AS cnt, MAX(r.reply_contents) AS answer, ( CASE WHEN COUNT(r.reply_idx) > 0 THEN '답변완료' ELSE '미답변' END ) AS answerStatus FROM tb_board b LEFT JOIN tb_member m ON b.board_create_idx = m.member_idx LEFT JOIN tb_reply r ON b.board_idx = r.reply_board_idx GROUP BY b.board_idx, b.board_title, b.board_create_idx, m.member_id, b.board_create_date, b.board_hit_cnt ORDER BY b.board_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_reply (reply_contents, reply_board_idx, reply_create_idx) VALUES (#{answer}, #{id}, #{writer})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_reply SET reply_contents = #{answer}, reply_create_date = NOW() WHERE reply_board_idx = #{id}
